description: This Java class implements an immutable version of the SubjectType interface, providing methods for creation, comparison, and string representation of a subject type.

classes.name: ImmutableSubjectType
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the SubjectType interface, encapsulating a string representing the subject type and providing fundamental object methods.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new ImmutableSubjectType instance after validating input.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the subject type string.

methods.name: charAt
methods.description: Returns the character at the specified index.

methods.name: subSequence
methods.description: Returns a subsequence of the subject type string.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the encapsulated subject type string.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code based on the subject type string.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the subject type.
